# Zeeshan Ali Khan — Full Profile

Senior Software Engineer & Conversational AI Engineer based in Berlin, Germany.
Email: ZeeshanAliKhan15@gmail.com

## Positioning

Senior Software Engineer and Conversational AI Engineer who builds voice and chat AI agents that handle real customer conversations, backed by 12+ years of real-time contact center systems.

His edge: he understands both sides of a voice agent — the AI and the telephony it runs on.

He is an applied-AI engineer (not ML research): he builds with existing models (LLMs, speech-to-text, text-to-speech), choosing, combining, prompting, orchestrating and evaluating them in production.

## Career journey

1. **Afiniti (2014–2021):** Grew from Analyst to Principal Software Engineer, building real-time integrations that connected Afiniti's AI routing platform to enterprise contact centers.
2. **virtualQ (2018–2024):** Built real-time CTI connectors between a cloud callback platform and many contact center platforms.
3. **virtualQ (2024–present):** Moved into conversational AI, building voice and chat AI agents on the same platform.

## Experience

### Senior Software Engineer — virtualQ (Berlin · Nov 2024 – Present)

- Built production conversational voice agents using Pipecat, Twilio, AWS Transcribe, AWS Bedrock and Anthropic models, with live phone deployment and human handoff.
- Designed multi-step agent dialogues with Pipecat Flows, scoping context and tool calls to each step so calls stay predictable and test cases are reproducible.
- Built AI agent workflows (multi-step logic, tool calling, automations) with LangChain and LangGraph.
- Added speech-to-text and real-time translation with Deepgram, AWS Transcribe and AWS Translate; built Retell AI phone agents.
- Reduced voice agent costs with spam-call blocking on Twilio and SignalWire, and by connecting SignalWire directly to Retell AI.
- Built a kiosk-style, no-code agent builder that turns a customer's key business functions into a working agent in a few clicks.
- Full-stack features with Ruby on Rails, React and Node.js; code reviews and mentoring junior developers.

### Call Center Integration Developer — virtualQ (Remote · Aug 2018 – Oct 2024)

- Built multi-threaded, async C#/.NET connectors syncing live agent, caller and call data between enterprise contact centers (Avaya Elite, AACC, CIE, Voxtron, Asterisk) and the virtualQ cloud callback platform.
- Built an Asterisk connector that lets virtualQ connect to any ACD over SIP with no client-side changes, similar to Twilio BYOC.
- Built and published the virtualQ.Net REST API client library and a connector auto-updater on NuGet.

### Afiniti (Lahore, Pakistan · Jun 2014 – Oct 2021)

Principal Software Engineer (Apr 2021 – Oct 2021), Senior Software Engineer (Nov 2017 – Mar 2021), Software Engineer (Sep 2016 – Nov 2017), Analyst Software Engineer (Jun 2014 – Aug 2016).

- Built real-time integrations in C#/.NET, C++ and Java connecting Afiniti's AI routing platform to enterprise contact centers on Avaya (AES, CM, TSAPI/DMCC, ASAI, Aura, POM), Genesys PureConnect (ININ), Genesys PureCloud and Amazon Connect.
- Developed proxies, web services and multi-threaded distributed applications with TCP/IP socket programming.
- Built switch simulators and multi-agent apps to load test call routing at scale.

## Featured projects

### Conversational Voice AI Agent Platform (flagship)
End-to-end voice and chat AI agents for contact center customers, from telephony to UI. Live calls over Twilio and SignalWire, speech-to-text and real-time translation, LLM conversations as multi-step flows with scoped tools, human handoff, spam-call blocking, n8n automations, and a kiosk-style no-code agent builder.
Tech: Pipecat, Pipecat Flows, LangChain, LangGraph, Retell AI, Twilio, SignalWire, AWS Transcribe, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Deepgram, AWS Translate, n8n, React.

### Contact center connectors (virtualQ)
Avaya Elite, Avaya AACC, Avaya CIE, Voxtron QConnect, and vQube Asterisk connectors; virtualQ.Net REST client and Connector Auto Updater.
Tech: C#, DMCC, AES, CM, SMS, TCP, Multicast, REST, SOAP, IVR, Asterisk AMI/AGI/ARI, SIP.

### Afiniti integrations
Genesys PureConnect (ININ) integration, Avaya Elite Simulator, PureConnect Simulator, X-Agent Application, and Agent Application.
Tech: C#, IceLib API, Dialer API, ASAI protocol, TCP async sockets.

### Academic

- Compiler: a basic compiler for a subset of C++ (Java, CFG, regular expressions).
